P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely typographic.

P05.rationale: There are no case study client portraits or named profile images present on the page.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial block is present.

P10.rationale: A faint ghost letter 'A' watermark appears in the upper-right background, but it is very subtle and not a strongly deployed decorative typographic device.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, charts, before/after comparisons, or cost-math graphics are present; the page is purely text.

P12.rationale: The upper half has reasonable text density with a two-column article layout, but the lower half is dominated by a single large pull-quote with significant empty space, making the overall fill sparse.

P13.rationale: The dark gradient/tonal background provides some atmospheric quality, but it is largely flat with only a subtle ghost letterform adding minimal texture.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no imagery at all, so there is no generic stock photography to penalise, though the absence of any specific visuals is itself a compositional weakness.

N08.rationale: The lower half of the page is largely empty aside from the oversized pull-quote, creating a large region of purposeless dead whitespace below the dividing rule.

N10.rationale: There is no photograph with overlaid text and no awkward inset gaps; all text sits cleanly on the flat background.
